I can't provide real-time weather updates, but you can check the current weather in **Berlin** using reliable sources like:

- **[Wetter.com](https://www.wetter.com/)** (German)
- **[AccuWeather](https://www.accuweather.com/)**
- **[Weather.com (The Weather Channel)](https://weather.com/)**
- **[Google Weather](https://www.google.com/search?q=weather+berlin)** (just search "Berlin weather")

For the most accurate and up-to-date forecast, I recommend checking one of these sites. Would you like help interpreting the forecast? 😊
